alate: Head black; postclypeus, antennae, labrum, labial palps, maxillary palps, pronotum, abdominal tergites and sternites, legs and wings all dark brown, slightly paler than the head. Body densely covered with hairs.
biology: It lives in the soil and feeds on decayed wood and rotting grass and leaves.
distribution: Wushe, Taiwan; Zhejiang; Jian'ou, Pinghe and Changting, Fujian; Chongqing; Guangxi; Shaoguan and Zhanjiang, Guangdong; Hainan; Mount Dawei, Pingbian, Yunnan (altitude 1500 m).
soldier: Head brownish yellow or reddish brown, antennae, labrum and the remaining mouthparts yellow-white, mandibles reddish brown to blackish brown, thorax pale yellow, abdomen white and opaque. Head, thorax and abdomen all bearing numerous hairs, the head held downwards and not parallel with the thorax and abdomen. Head flattened-cylindrical, about two-thirds as wide as long (to the mandibular base), the posterior part roundly arched, the sides nearly parallel, the anterior part slightly narrowed, the median longitudinal suture of the posterior dorsum distinct and not reaching the mid-point of the head. Antennae 14 segments, the first long and large, the second small and cylindrical, about half as long as the first and equal in length to the fourth. Labrum more than one and a half times as long as wide, with sabre-like projections on either side of the apex. Fontanelle a small shallow pit at one-fifth of the head from the front, with a groove in front of it extending to the postclypeus. Postmentum projecting distinctly on the ventral surface. Mandibles long and sabre-like, twisted in a sloping manner, the left more strongly curved and hooked at the tip, the right rather straight and also hooked at the apex. Pronotum distinctly narrower than the head, saddle-shaped, its anterior part raised, the centres of the anterior and posterior margins almost without incisions.
